summary: American Woodmark (AMWD) filed an 8-K updating its pending merger with MasterBrand, Inc. under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated August 5, 2025. The filing discloses that three American Woodmark-designated directors (Andrew Cogan, Philip Fracassa, Daniel Hendrix) will join MasterBrand's board upon closing, increasing its size from 8 to 11 directors. The merger is expected to close in Q2 2026, subject to FTC clearance and customary conditions. No deal price, premium, or advisor is stated. American Woodmark will not issue an earnings release or hold a conference call due to the pending transaction. Watch for regulatory clearance updates.
